title: Phone and Focus Mode walks can be replayed: tap any step to go back to it, and restart the whole update from the first step

requirements.text: In the phone app and in Mac Focus Mode, tapping an earlier step replays it, and a restart control plays every step of the current update again from the beginning
requirements.check: On the phone and in Focus Mode, skip past a step, tap it and hear it again; press restart and hear every step from the first

text: Built both sides. Phone: tap a step on the bar (32dp target) = rewind to it (WalkPlan.rewind, Walker.rewind), Start-over button in the transport, 'Hear all N again' on All caught up and At work; walked persisted, cleared only when a new update arrives (Play after Pause kept wiping it). Mac Focus Mode: same (DeskWalk.rewind, clickable segments, backward.end button, cmd-shift-left). Re-answers replace the held answer. Phone 47/0 + APK builds; swift test 208/0. Left: TJ's eye on both.
